- Build and maintain internal tools, management systems, workflow dashboards, and client-facing operational platforms for cross-border Chinese SMEs, semiconductor companies, and engineering teams, including direct integration with Chinese digital platforms (WeChat ecosystem, Alipay, China-specific cloud APIs) using Chinese-language API documentation.
- Develop and maintain software tools, scripts, and workflow automation systems that support IC design operations, including DFT workflows, Verilog-based digital logic design, verification pipelines, and EDA tool environments (Cadence and Synopsys) — covering environment configuration, licence server management, and build-flow automation.
- Deploy, configure, monitor, and maintain applications on Linux-based server environments across Mainland China and international infrastructure, including ICP-filed domains, China-based hosting, cross-border DNS and CDN configuration, reverse proxy setup (Nginx), and environment-specific application configuration. Troubleshoot infrastructure issues specific to China-facing deployments, including Great Firewall constraints and dual-environment architectures.
- Identify technology limitations, performance bottlenecks, and process gaps across existing systems, then independently design, implement, and document improvements — maintaining technical documentation, API references, deployment runbooks, and operational procedures in both English and Chinese.
- Analyse operational metrics, system performance data, user feedback, and error reports to drive continuous improvement across all systems under management.
- Serve as the primary technical point of contact for bilingual teams, Chinese clients, and stakeholders across China, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Australia, conducting requirements gathering and technical communication in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Technical Requirements

Required

- Hands-on experience in full-stack web development, with demonstrated ability to independently deliver complete systems from front-end to backend to deployment.
- Strong proficiency in Python as a primary backend language, with production experience in Django, Flask, or FastAPI for building database-backed web applications and API services.
- Production experience developing front-end interfaces using React or Vue (not merely prototyping), including state management, component architecture, API integration, and responsive design.
- Demonstrated experience building and maintaining internal tools, admin panels, operational dashboards, and workflow management platforms for business users.
- Solid understanding of RESTful API design, relational database modelling (PostgreSQL or MySQL), authentication and authorisation systems, third-party API integration, and system-to-system communication patterns.
- Hands-on Linux server administration experience, including setup, configuration, application deployment, Nginx reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS management, firewall rules, log management, cron jobs, process supervision, and production troubleshooting — not merely development on Linux.
- Practical experience with Docker containerisation, CI/CD pipeline configuration, and cloud or hybrid server deployment environments.
- Working knowledge of digital IC design workflows, including an understanding of DFT (Design for Test) concepts, Verilog HDL, digital logic design, synthesis, and verification processes — sufficient to develop, configure, and maintain software tools and workflow integrations that support IC design engineering teams.
- Direct experience working with EDA tool environments, specifically Cadence and/or Synopsys toolchains, including at least one of: tool installation and environment configuration, licence server setup and management, build-flow scripting and automation, or integration of EDA tools into broader engineering workflow platforms.
- Familiarity with ARM Cortex and/or RISC-V processor architectures and MCU-based development workflows, with sufficient understanding to build and maintain software systems that support semiconductor engineering and production operations.
- Demonstrated experience with Mainland China infrastructure and compliance requirements, including ICP filing processes, China-based hosting configuration, China-accessible domain and DNS setup, and deployment of applications that function reliably behind the Great Firewall.
- Experience building operational software systems for Chinese businesses, including direct integration with Chinese digital platforms, services, or APIs (e.g., WeChat ecosystem, Alipay, China-based cloud providers), with the ability to independently read and implement from Chinese-language technical documentation.

Preferred

- Experience developing automation scripts, engineering workflow tools, internal development platforms, or integration layers specifically for semiconductor or IC design teams in China.
- Understanding of MCU, semiconductor, embedded systems, or IC design industries in Greater China and broader Asia, particularly where software platforms support engineering, production, or client delivery workflows.
- Experience with software performance optimisation, security hardening, monitoring and alerting systems, and deployment automation for production environments operating across multiple jurisdictions.
- Familiarity with cross-border data handling, dual-environment deployment architectures (China/international), and the operational constraints of running software services that must function in both mainland Chinese and international network environments simultaneously.
- Experience working in small teams or as a sole technical operator with full ownership of systems from requirements through to production support.

Language & Communication

- Proficient in English.
- Fluent Mandarin Chinese, both spoken and written, is required.
- Ability to communicate technical requirements, system issues, software specifications, and deployment matters with Chinese clients and Mandarin-speaking stakeholders.
- Ability to read and interpret Chinese platform documentation, API documentation, compliance materials, and technical communication; draft technical communications in Chinese for mainland stakeholders; and navigate Chinese-language developer resources, forums, and support channels without assistance.

result.description:
Riot Sydney is looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join the Sydney-based League, gameplay team. 

As Software Engineers at Riot, we bring deep knowledge of specific technical areas and also value the opportunity to work in a variety of broader domains. We work with both new and current technology, creating innovative solutions to overcome high-volume obstacles and to deliver player value.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Game team under League’s Gameplay initiative, you will bring deep gameplay technical knowledge and skills to the game play domains in League of Legends. You will increase sustainability for new/existing game modes and develop tools and workflows that make it easier for designers and artists to create awesome experiences for our players. You will work as part of a diverse team consisting of artists, designers, engineers, producers, and QA. You will contribute to technical decision-making processes, driving team-level decisions in alignment with product goals. You will report to the Team Engineering Manager.

This is a full-time role, based in Sydney, Australia. Internal Job Title: Software Engineer II. 

Responsibilities:
Develop and implement improvements to help League of Legends maintain and scale game modes more sustainably.
Understand backend services powering League of Legends and collaborate with the team to use them effectively.
Automate aspects of creating and running new and existing game modes.
Design and develop features and UI in the League of Legends game engine using C++.
Work closely with cross-disciplinary teams in Sydney and the US (Game Designers, Artists, Animators, Quality, and Producers) to shape engaging player experiences.
Provide feedback to designers and artists on technical tradeoffs of their designs and ideas.
Participate in team technical decisions and contribute to the overall product direction.
Mentor and support less experienced engineers.
Participate in team's on-call rotation where you may be required to be on-call during certain periods outside of your normal working hours

Required Qualifications: 
4+ yrs of collective professional experience building applications or games in a client-server architecture.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or comparable field or equivalent experience
Experience working closely with non-engineering collaborators to deliver value
Experience building games
Experience working with complex code bases
Professional experience using C++

For this role, you'll succeed through craft expertise and a collaborative spirit that prioritises the delight of players. We will look at your past studies and experience, but for this role, we also look for dedicated people with a personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this is the role for you!

Job Description
Position Overview:
AI Talent, a pioneer in AI-powered solutions, is looking for a meticulous and experienced Software Tester to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for verifying the quality and performance of our AI applications by creating and executing test plans, identifying defects, and working closely with developers to ensure prompt resolution.
The ideal candidate will bring a solid grasp of software testing methodologies, sharp analytical skills, and a strong commitment to delivering high-quality AI software. Experience with test automation tools is a plus.
Responsibilities:
Collaborate with the development team and project stakeholders to understand software requirements and design comprehensive test plans and test cases for AI software applications.
Perform functional, integration, system, and regression testing to validate the performance, accuracy, and reliability of AI software products.
Identify and document software defects, including clear and detailed reproduction steps, in a bug tracking system. Collaborate with the development team to ensure timely resolution of issues.
Develop and maintain automated test scripts using industry-standard software testing automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Appium, or Robot Framework) to streamline testing processes and improve test efficiency for AI software applications.
Create and maintain test documentation, including test plans, test cases, and test reports, to ensure comprehensive test coverage and facilitate knowledge sharing within the team.
Set up and configure test environments, including hardware, software, and data, to simulate real-world scenarios and ensure accurate testing results.
Continuously evaluate and enhance software testing strategies, methodologies, and tools to improve the overall quality and efficiency of testing processes.
Work closely with the development team, product owners, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify issues, and provide timely feedback on the quality of AI software products.
Collaborate with the QA team to establish and maintain quality standards, best practices, and processes across AI software projects.
Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and advancements in software testing methodologies, AI technologies, and industry best practices.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Must have at least 2 years of proven experience as a Software Tester, with a strong understanding of software testing methodologies and practices.
Experience in testing AI software applications and familiarity with AI concepts and technologies.
Solid knowledge of test management tools, bug tracking systems, and test automation frameworks.
Experience with software testing automation tools such as Selenium, Appium, Robot Framework, or similar.
Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in software testing, such as Python or Java.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and isolate software defects effectively.
Excellent attention to detail and ability to meticulously follow test plans and test cases.
Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Experience with Agile development methodologies is a plus.
Relevant certifications in software testing, such as ISTQB, are desirable.
Permanent Residents (PR) and Australian Citizens are eligible to apply
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $70,000 to $120,000 per year + super
